findings.rootCause: The lexical-row ledger found dictionary records but no contextual name candidates. The builder skips proper-name candidates whenever any dictionary entries exist. Final adjudication relabeled Salomon, Abiam and Abias as blank-unit-member, retaining e1/e7/e9 as pending. The UI accurately exposed that missing allocation.
findings.repair: Hash-bound whole-verse occurrence review assigns Solomon, the object Abia and the following subject Abia to their respective Latin occurrences. Both canonical word banks and all punctuation stay unchanged.

findings.rootCause: Parser missed the explicit TR+Byz spelling in TAGNT column 8. RP2018 Asa failed exact alignment to TAGNT base Asaph; the fallback selected the shared G0760 dictionary brief gloss Asaph.
findings.repair: Resolve the explicitly named edition spelling only when the same TAGNT record supplies the matching single proper-name lemma and English. Copy the published name Asa. Full source scan finds exactly two affected records: Matthew 1:7 and 1:8. No Greek source text is changed.

findings.status: Final letter is not displayed as ink. CNTR proposed reading and TAGNT English remain marked as proposed. Published secondary transcription ασα[φ?] is consistent with uncertainty but is not manuscript-image certification.
findings.otherDistinctReading: P1 αβεια remains distinct from Vaticanus αβια.
